description: A 2018 run mixes garden problems with homemade technology as Pat and Mat deal with bees, solar mowing, a mole, a carousel, fencing, drains, surveillance, a blocked chimney, landscaping, power generation, rodeo machinery, stairs and a dishwasher.

s12e01.description: Bees settle into Pat and Mat's surroundings, and the pair respond with homemade protective measures and inventive attempts to manage the swarm without abandoning the garden.

s12e02.description: Mowing the lawn seems like an ideal task to automate, so Pat and Mat build a solar-powered mower and discover that sunlight, steering and grass do not automatically cooperate.

s12e03.description: A mole begins reshaping the garden from below, prompting Pat and Mat to devise a series of increasingly elaborate ways to locate, divert and out-engineer the underground visitor.

s12e04.description: Pat and Mat decide to build a carousel, transforming ordinary materials into a homemade amusement ride whose balance and motion demand rather more engineering than anticipated.

s12e05.description: A fence needs building or repair, and Pat and Mat turn posts, panels and alignment into a chain of structural improvisations where every straight section creates the next problem.

s12e06.description: A clogged drain refuses to clear by ordinary means, so Pat and Mat escalate from simple plumbing tools to a broader system for forcing the blockage somewhere, preferably away from them.

s12e07.description: Pat and Mat install a security camera to keep watch over their property, then have to solve positioning, coverage and monitoring problems created by their own surveillance setup.

s12e08.description: A blocked chimney sends Pat and Mat onto another vertical repair job, where reaching the obstruction and clearing it safely becomes a contest between gravity and improvisation.

s12e09.description: Pat and Mat decide to create a rock garden, arranging stones and landscaping the space until moving decorative rocks becomes a problem requiring machinery rather than gardening.

s12e10.description: Needing their own supply of electricity, Pat and Mat assemble a homemade generator and then work through the practical difficulties of turning motion, wiring and household demand into usable power.

s12e11.description: Pat and Mat bring the spirit of a rodeo home, building their own version of the challenge and discovering that controlling a mechanical ride is easier in theory than from the saddle.

s12e12.description: A staircase project confronts Pat and Mat with height, spacing and support, so they devise their own route upward one improvised step at a time.

s12e13.description: A dishwasher promises to remove an everyday chore, but installation and operation give Pat and Mat enough plumbing and mechanical trouble to ensure the machine creates work before it saves any.
